REFERRING PHYSICIAN: Dr. [redacted name]

TEST PERFORMED
DNA Extraction and Biobanking

RESULT
DNA successfully extracted from peripheral blood sample and stored in the laboratory biobank for future genetic testing as requested.

Sample Details:
- DNA concentration: 125 ng/μL
- Total yield: 50 μg
- A260/A280 ratio: 1.85
- Storage location: -80°C freezer, Box [redacted ID]

No specific genetic testing has been performed at this time. The extracted DNA sample is available for future molecular genetic analyses upon request.

RECOMMENDATIONS
Please contact the laboratory at [redacted phone] to request specific genetic testing on this stored sample. Written consent may be required for certain test types.

DISCLAIMERS
- Sample identification is based on information provided at the time of collection. The laboratory cannot verify patient identity or biological relationships.
- This report is based on the assumption that the specimen submitted is correctly labeled with the patient's name.
- Family relationships stated in this report are based on information provided and have not been independently verified through genetic testing.
- Clerical errors, including transcription errors, although rare, can occur. Please contact the laboratory if any discrepancies are noted.

This test was developed and its performance characteristics determined by [redacted location] Medical Center Molecular Genetics Laboratory.

Electronically signed by:
[redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director
